title: Page Functional Profile
description: The inter-agent contract for funcspec. Every page-evaluator agent returns one document conforming to this schema. The orchestrator merges profiles in Phase 4 (synthesis). Keep additions backward-compatible: synthesis keys off `id` fields.

source_path.description: Path to the page/composite source file evaluated

visual_verified.description: True when Phase 3 visual verification ran against the rendered story

summary.description: 2-4 sentences: what this page is for and who uses it

user_goals.description: Jobs the user accomplishes here, e.g. 'find an overdue invoice and send a reminder'

affordances.description: Every interactive or state-bearing element and the behavior it implies. This is the core evidence table.

element.description: What + where, e.g. 'Export CSV button, table toolbar'

implied_behavior.description: The functionality the element implies, stated as a requirement, e.g. 'Generates a CSV of the current filtered invoice set and downloads it'

operation_refs.description: ids of operations this affordance triggers

confidence.description: high = label/handler/mock data agree; medium = plausible inference; low = guess, must surface in ambiguities

evidence.description: The code or visual fact backing the inference, e.g. "onClick={handleExport}, mock rows have 12 columns"

entities.description: Data objects inferred from props, mock data shapes, and rendered fields.

type.description: string | number | boolean | date | enum | ref:<Entity> | array<...>

enum_values.description: For status badges etc. — the values actually seen

evidence.description: Where the shape came from, e.g. 'mockInvoices in data.ts'

operations.description: Implied API surface. Each operation is something a backend must support.

intent.description: Plain-language statement, e.g. 'Fetch invoices filtered by status and date range'

crud.description: 'action' = domain verb (send, approve, archive); 'query' = parameterized read (search/filter/sort/paginate)

realtime.description: True if the UI implies live updates (presence, streaming counts, notifications)

navigation.description: Route and transition cues: links, breadcrumbs, sidebar items, row-click drill-downs, post-action redirects.

target.description: Inferred destination page id or route, e.g. 'invoice-detail' / '/invoices/:id'

states.description: UI states the page must handle. Record both states present in the design AND states the design omits but the functionality requires.

present_in_design.description: False = the design never shows it; flag as a gap

roles.description: Permission/visibility cues: admin-only buttons, 'assigned to me' filters, owner labels.

cue.description: The evidence, e.g. 'Delete button only in mock data where role === admin'

affects.description: affordance ids gated by this role

ambiguities.description: Anything with two plausible readings or no evidence. These feed the Stage-2 interview and the gap register — record, never guess silently.

question.description: The question to put to the user, e.g. 'Does Archive soft-delete or permanently remove?'

readings.description: The plausible interpretations, first = evaluator's best guess

blocking.description: True if the implementation plan cannot proceed sensibly without an answer

resolution.description: Filled in after the Stage-2 interview

notes.description: Anything the evaluator observed that fits nowhere else (perf cues, accessibility flags, design inconsistencies)
